The first and the entered into the domain of the one and said: “I think that I should very much have liked to have been given a choice in the matter of the signing.” “I think I could have negotiated better terms.” The pen was dropped by the one and the room went silent but for the two heartbeats facing one another across the table. The hum of absentminded routine that had, until the words had been uttered, filled the room with constant motion and noise of these two going through the same motions that had always passed there before was broken. “The problem is that I don’t think I was consulted, and if I was, I don’t think I was given a chance to make an informed decision. Duress! That’s what I’d have called it back there.” Then, a voice containing the incomprehensible power of planets crashing together and their vast frozen oceans crackling into steam and back to ice whispered from the mouth of the one and teased; “Duress?” and raising its eyes to meet those of the first across the table said aloud “tell me in what way you were compelled to take my bargain.” “Well I suppose it’s because there was nothing before and now there’s something and I don’t remember having this type of conversation until I turned up here.”
“Now that I’m here I’m told that this was the bargain I made because I took part in it all, but while I was there I was oblivious to the details of the agreement and the consequences of trying to deviate from the plan. All the rules were made murky by the perspective I had and while I may have had an instinct for what was right and wrong I also had many competing instincts telling me to behave differently and contrarily, so I imagine that were you in my place you too might be confused as to why, in the end you would be held to account for anything at all.” There was no hesitation because the one had its answer ready if unused and out of practice, and so said “There is only one will and it is mine.” “This is my universe from expanse to expanse there is nothing without or within that I am not. Your body and soul, your mind and heart, I am those and those of the rock and tree, sun and star and all others. Believe me when I say you are a part of a whole because I am that whole. I struck the bargain when I imbued you with life and gave you a will like mine to breath and speak independently from me. I am, you were.” Something like the glint of a pulsar shined lightly through the eye of the second as he finished as though he knew what was to come next. The first thought for a little while. The proceedings had been put on pause and all the attention of those in the room were on the thoughts racing around the head of the first. After the passage of some time the first responded with the following. “Well that’s all well and good and I’m sure that it’s very nice to be you, but I feel like that was the point I was making.” The first rose and paced excitedly in the small space and gestured frantically as the words came tumbling out. “It might be stating the obvious and it most certainly has been said before, but I never asked to be here and while I might be considered lucky to have been given the chance I often didn’t really want to be so lucky at all. It seems like it was only ever your decision and I might even have been fine with that if it weren’t for the damnable authority I had over my own will. I had no indication of what in the hell I was supposed to do with it other than what I could sense with my body and soul. That by the way is the problem with the others I was there with; we all had different things that our senses told us to do all the time, and they rarely matched up in any way with what the other wanted or anything and you never told us-“ “Be Silent” the one said and the first was. “I gave you your life, and you knew what to do with it. I gave you the promises of the universe and you were able to do with it all that was done. It was a self-fulfilling engine. You were in the exact situation that you were placed and there was no reason for it other than my will. Why did you suffer? Simply, because I allowed for the wills of many to be done and that is what they made to be. Why did countless numbers suffer before you? I do not abdicate responsibility but I do deny guilt. The suffering of the innocent in natural calamity is the great engine redesigning itself, for to paraphrase what one of the ones in this room before you said it is the marble and the sculptor. I am both and neither. I ordered that the work be done, separate but integral. Without me there would be no engine to sculpt itself and without the engine I would not see the work done.” “Speak” “Well I you’re just going to shut me up every time you have something to say then I don’t think that this can be a very productive conversation. “ The one laughed at this and the whole gamma ray bursts of its eyes shone with the infinite intensity of the first moment in its mirth. “I will no longer bind you will to my own, but you may end up regretting my benevolence.” The one turned away from the first and the first was allowed to speak once more “You did not show me the terms before the deal was made. I was a thought before I was even an infant, incapable of my own thoughts and yet I was thrust into this world meek and innocent and vulnerable. Some of the low beasts are not as unfortunate as this as they are born powerful and yet we are given dominion over them. How can this be? This means that we are at the mercy of the previous generation to teach us how to survive and the difference between right and wrong and we are to be damned if their teaching has diverged from truth over the eons of separation from the once true truth that you gave us.” “There is nothing that an infant can do to change or control its circumstances. We don’t even become aware of that privilege until somewhat later in our lives and by that time the indoctrination of the previous generation has begun and set firm. Had you intended us to make an informed choice to avoid your wrath or enter your glory, the decision should have been made in full view and knowledge of the consequences of those actions and should not be made blind. There, is after all nothing short of eternity on the line and you are obviously capable of so much more than reliance on luck. In fact that means that you had to have been relying on luck. That sounds an awful lot like willful endangerment to me, a lack of due diligence.” “You didn’t give me any sense of utility or purpose when I did what was good. In fact it often seemed that when I was there, the only way to get any satisfaction was to do those things that I knew to be wrong. If I wanted to kill my brother or my rival in order to surpass him, when I did then I met with success. If I wanted to have sexual satisfaction and I was strong all I had to do was take something weaker than myself and use it for pleasure and the rewards from this were immediate orgasm and possibly becoming a permanent contributor to life.” “The life that you gave us is predisposed towards violence and mean living. Something about it reeks of evil but we are neither told what or how and to what degree anything is acceptable.” “You left me abandoned when I was alone and overwhelmed when I needed solitude.” “I didn’t know what love was nor what love could be, except for a few texts that are difficult to understand and even more difficult to believe. And when love finally came the imposter lust tries to confuse it all into destroying everything.” “You make me angry, and tell me that I am wrong to be angry and weak but that weakness is strength. You make me suffer and tell me that suffering brings rewards and reward goodness with suffering. You give us enough knowledge to see the world but not enough to know it. Your machine is like any perpetual motion device in that its fundamental flaws either make it impossible to build or doomed to catastrophic failure without continuous corrections. If you are the source of the corrections then why bother with the illusion that you gave us a hope of free will. Is our will free or not? If it only feels free and we cannot tell then why punish us for playing by your rules if you don’t enjoy the suffering? If it is in fact free then how can you claim the authority to punish or reward it at all? What possible purpose does that serve other than to influence decisions and therefore remove some of the freedom you gave me. This means that you gave me a false sense of freedom and no way to check the reality. That is the lie you told me, and the lie you seem to believe.” There was some awareness on the part of the first that what had just been said was probably not all entirely consistent but anger had overruled judgement and it felt good to finally say these things to one who would listen and even knew the answers. “You are right. The machine is constantly breaking but it has infinite momentum and cannot stop. It remakes itself with every motion and the near random collisions of will make the whole thing very messy. “ “When two wills that aren’t my own collide there must be a result that neither willed because the will of one doesn’t exactly match the will of the other. This is where there is a lack of free will; where two equal wills interact. My will being greater than yours, I choose not to influence your will because to do so deprives you of any freedom, which is something that I intend for you to have. Therefore it is not me that is the cause of your trials but rather others like you and you yourself.”

“Look at the rest of my machine to see why I made you. It is perfect and unchanging, constantly different and remade and beautiful. And boring: So much infinite variety and so much infinite predictability. Is it a wonder that I insulated you from it by the expanse? Is it a wonder that in your existence there is only one place of unpredictable variety and wonder? I placed you there to change existence from something I watched and never needed to interact with to something that is an image of my being; which is to say I wanted to interact with it.” “Now I have interacted with you and your purpose is fulfilled. I have a question; would you like to keep on going, or should I remove you from existence?” “I don’t know. You’re changing the rules again. I thought that where I was, was all there was. If that was the case I’d rather not have had to do it in the first place. But if the point was to come here without knowledge of you so that we could interact as closely to something like equals as possible then I see your purpose.” “Now that I know what you are and that you’re there I still resent having been made to go through all that nonsense just to end up here. I still can’t really see the benefit of staying around. What happens if I do?” “I am here. Because of that your will will cease to influence reality and it will become my own. You will enjoy the bliss of what I am and that is something that I cannot share until you chose to. There are some for whom that existence has proven too difficult and they have chosen to separate themselves from my will and they suffer like I did before I realised existence. You seem to be seeking the third option which is to exit existence entirely. I have seen this before and I understand it. It is the core of the bargain. The fact that you can choose between these options justifies all that has gone before. “ The cold reality began to sink in on the first. There was no equality here but there was love. That love that a parent has for a child and the compassion that a great being has for a lesser one. The love for the first forced the one’s hand into letting the first suffer. It all made sense now that there was proof and it became clear that the bargain had only now even begun. Everything that had just happened did so only to give context for this moment. The truth became clear and it was overwhelming. Time past and they sat across from one another waiting and contemplating. “When I turn back to face to your decision will come. You will join your will to mine or choose to be separate from me and exist that way or cease to be entirely. Your decision is made.” The one intoned. The will of the first was made known and the one turned to face it. An empty chair remained and the one picked up the pen and made a note while the second came to fill it the empty chair.

I call this the Smokey the Bear argument. Let's think of a forest. Oftentimes, when faced with the maintenance of a forest, people fall for the steady state assumption and let the undergrowth grow out and out, and do their best to prevent forest fires that might hurt the trees. This encourages the undergrowth to get larger and larger, depriving the soil of nutrients and creating the perfect kindling for an unstoppable fire. Rather, a good conservator uses controlled burns to maintain a punctuated equilibrium that averages out to resemble a respectable arrangement of the plants in a natural forest. The forest is humanity, controlled burn is fat shaming, the undergrowth is obesity (or really and other un-respectable trait that people embody). Better to have a small risk of danger from a controlled burn than a large risk of danger from a California sized wildfire.
